title: Cash or miles for this trip?
intro: Compare a cash ticket with an award ticket for the same trip—even on different flights—using your own value per mile.
examples: Domestic defaults: Economy ¥1.50; JAL Class J ¥2 and First ¥3; ANA Premium Class ¥2.50 per mile. International: Economy ¥2, Business ¥4, First ¥6. These editable thresholds are personal preferences, not market prices. Saved targets are preserved.
perPerson: Enter totals for one person and the entire journey. Cash fares must include all charges.
feeHint: Enter 0 when there is no charge. In breakdown mode, complete every fee field.
value: Value per mile vs this cash option
incomplete: Enter miles and award cash charges
needCash: Add a cash fare to compare
formula1: Value per mile = (cash fare − award cash charges) ÷ miles required
formula2: Break-even cash fare = miles required × target value + award cash charges
footer: For JAL miles on JAL flights and ANA miles on ANA flights. Excludes miles earned on paid tickets. An independent tool, not affiliated with either airline.
empty: Add a cash-versus-miles comparison for this trip.
confirmGroup: Delete this trip and its comparisons?
confirmImport: Replace your current data with this backup?
invalid: Invalid backup. Choose a supported JSON backup file.
storage: Browser saving is unavailable. Export a backup to keep your data.
corrupt: Saved data could not be read and has been left untouched. Download a recovery copy before resetting.
confirmReset: Reset saved data and start again? Download a recovery copy first.
targetError: Enter a target greater than 0 and no more than 10,000.
numberError: Enter nonnegative whole numbers for amounts and miles.
limit: You can save up to 100 trips and 100 comparisons per trip.
backupHint: Clearing browser data removes your comparisons. Export JSON to keep a backup.
eyebrow: A little clarity. A better journey.
splitHint: The previous total is placed under Other fees. Edit the fields to match the actual breakdown.
groupLimit: You can save up to 100 trips and 100 comparisons per trip.
valuationNote: Miles are valued at your target rate. This is a valuation difference, not cash savings.
comparisonHint: Choose flights that both work for the same trip. Also consider differences in airports, times, cabin, baggage, and flexibility.
lookupTitle: Estimate miles from an award chart (optional)
lookupScope: Selected direct international routes between Tokyo and the listed cities, in either direction. Same cabin both ways; no connections, partner flights, or premium economy. City choices do not confirm flight or cabin availability.
lookupSeasonHint: When a season is required, check each departure date in the linked airline chart. Seasons are selected manually, not inferred from dates.
lookupUnavailable: Choose a supported route, cabin, and any required seasons. Otherwise enter miles manually.
lookupEstimate: Chart estimate: {{miles}} miles per person for the whole trip
jalChartHint: JAL: base mileage only. Award Ticket PLUS can increase the booking price; first class uses seasonal chart values. Check the airline for actual availability and miles.
anaChartHint: ANA: seasonal chart mileage, not a live availability or reservation quote.
lookupEditHint: Applying fills miles and the award route label. Miles remain editable. Changing lookup choices does not replace entered miles: apply again if needed. Fuel surcharge and taxes are entered separately.
chartChecked: Chart data checked: {{date}}. Stored reference data; verify with the airline before booking.
